LESSON: LANGUAGE WELCOME AND

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Language Welcome and

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Language Welcome and. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how are you? What is your name?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

You will learn the key ideas about Language Welcome and and use them at home and at school.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

Read about Language Welcome and with your parent or teacher. Say what it means in your own words.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Language Welcome and.
2. Explain Language Welcome and to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Language Welcome and.
4. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Language Welcome and. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: how are you? What is your name?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Language Welcome and is important in everyday life.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
